manifest.comparison: Record every logit/map difference; do not loosen a tolerance or exclude discrepant frames. Archived logits were generated on a historical GPU path; current inference is frozen-source CPU FP32.
manifest.cost_scope: Executed Conv2d and Linear MACs only. Pooling, normalization, activation, decision, transfer and dispatch are excluded; no wall-time conversion.

interpretation: Map equality only validates these frozen controls on these53frames atQP32. It is not all-beta, all-QP, hardware-independent equality, final-image quality or runtime. If changed_cases is nonempty, archived-map quality must not be labelled fresh-router output without decoding the changed maps.
